name: Elihu (son of Barakel)
title: The youngest of Job's friends
summary: Elihu, son of Barakel the Buzite, was the youngest of those who spoke with Job. He waited to speak until the elders had finished, and pointed out God's greatness and righteousness before the Lord himself answered Job.

keyEvents.title: Spoke to Job
keyEvents.description: Elihu, the youngest, became angry and spoke up when the three older friends fell silent, speaking about God's wisdom and justice.
